errors.description: fuse_word_q is a multi-bit value produced in fuse_clk and sampled directly in core_clk without a bundled-data handshake or hold guarantee.
fuse_done_pulse_q is a one-cycle fuse_clk pulse consumed directly in core_clk, so the event can be missed or sampled metastably.
fuse_done_toggle_q reconverges with a one-sample core_clk history, allowing metastability or double-counting in core_event_o.
shadow_mode_sync_q receives independently synchronized bits from encoded control vector shadow_mode_q before decoding in core_clk, so transient illegal modes can be observed.
fuse_rst_n is used as data inside core_clk logic, so reset deassertion can asynchronously change destination state.
otp_snapshot_q combines fuse_clk payload state with core_clk status state in otp_clk without a cross-domain snapshot protocol.
